claim: From 1 Feb to Dec 2026 the ground floor of Hof Ragaz is under modernization; Memories opens 5 Feb, Wed–Sat 19:00–21:30; inclusive thermal spa, transfer from Bad Ragaz station, Tamina Therme access are part of resort stays.
quote: From February 1 to December 2026 the ground floor of the Grand Hotel Hof Ragaz will undergo extensive modernization. Sven Wassmer Memories: Opens Feb 5 (Wed-Sat 7-9:30pm). Transfer service from Bad Ragaz train station.

claim: Grand Resort Bad Ragaz: Tripadvisor #1 of 7 in Bad Ragaz, 4.7/5 from 1,162 reviews; nightly rate $724–$1,470; value 4.4/5.
quote: Overall 4.7/5 bubbles; 1,162 reviews; #1 of 7 hotels in Bad Ragaz; nightly rate $724–$1,470; value 4.4 of 5.

claim: Hotel Palais Bad Ragaz is the oldest building of the resort (18th c.), 14 rooms, member of Relais & Châteaux; houses IGNIV and Zollstube.
quote: A total of 14 rooms and suites offer princely elegance and historic charm... home to two excellent restaurants: IGNIV by Andreas Caminada and the Restaurant Zollstube... member of Relais & Châteaux.

claim: Grand Resort campus includes Grand Hotel Quellenhof, Spa Suites, Grand Hotel Hof Ragaz, and Hotel Palais Bad Ragaz; Spa Suites are modern with thermal-water access.
quote: Spa Suites: Modern & purist... blend wellness and design with access to thermal water.

claim: Grand Hotel Quellenhof has been renovated by architect Claudio Carbone, blending tradition with contemporary style.
quote: Renovations planned by star Swiss architect Claudio Carbone allowing the long-established hotel to break into a new era of luxury hospitality.

claim: Boutique Hotel Ochsen has 17 light-filled rooms at Bartholomépl. 4, 7310 Bad Ragaz, in a fully renovated building.
quote: Bartholomépl. 4, 7310 Bad Ragaz; 17 light-filled, spacious and luxurious rooms; renovation of the whole building has given the restaurant, as well as the hotel Bad Ragaz, a unique charm.

claim: Boutique Hotel Ochsen rated 7.3/10 by Booking.com from 1,121 reviews; some guests report street noise from rooms on the main road.
quote: Rated 7.3 out of 10 by Booking.com guests based on 1,121 verified reviews. Some guests reported noise disturbances from the street.

claim: Hotel Krone by b-smart is a 3-star self-check-in property with 14 rooms, no on-site parking; rates from $95.
quote: 3-star business-friendly hotel with 14 accommodations; automated check-in; difficult to find parking as there is no hotel parking; rates from $95.

claim: Esos Hotel Quelle is a 3-star golf hotel in central Bad Ragaz with free breakfast, free WiFi, and free parking.
quote: Esos Hotel Quelle is a 3-star golf hotel in Bad Ragaz that offers free breakfast, free WiFi, and free parking.

claim: Hotel Schloss Ragaz is a 5-minute walk from Tamina Thermal Baths and roughly 30 minutes from Bad Ragaz station; reviews mixed on cleanliness and bed comfort; avg rate ~$244.
quote: Approximately a five-minute walk from the Tamina Thermal Baths... within a 30-minute walk of Maienfeld Railway Station and Bad Ragaz Railway Station; many expressed dissatisfaction with the cleanliness and comfort of the beds; average $244 per night.
